title: Scientists finally uncover why statins can cause muscle pain
caption:
Researchers have finally visualised why some people experience muscle pain from cholesterol medication. By seeing the drug at an atomic level, they found it physically jams open a vital protein gate.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists finally uncover why statins can cause muscle pain

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261019093447.htm

Written in our own words. Credit for the research belongs to the study authors and their institution.
